title: Hole in the closet
content: Has anyone else encountered a hole in the back of your walk in closet, which you can crawl through and access a windowless room with a rack of clothing? I've had reoccurring dreams about it, the hole seems to be getting smaller, but the room inside stays the same. I believe I've also had dreams where I find another hole dug in the wall in this room, which leads to another similar room. There is no light in the room, so it's difficult to look through the garments on the clothing rack, but I believe that most of them are button-ups?
